objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object created to attach information to a document; used when attaching new information to documents.

objs.name: document
objs.description: Primary object representing documents such as policies, guidelines, and instructions.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used in the document name to indicate the document type.

attributes.name: consecutive_number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client four-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References that relate to the document (References attribute in properties).

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity for the document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle; used for supplementary information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Tied to the main document; attachments released with the main document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Attachment equipment associated with a document; has its own versioning.

evts.name: attachmentofnewinformationobject
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to a document.

evts.name: attachmentofnewdocumentobject
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object in the system.

evts.name: documentconvertedtopdf
evts.description: Document converted automatically to PDF after saving.

evts.name: releaseprocessinitiated
evts.description: Release process (Creator - Review - Release) started for a document.

evts.name: documentreleased
evts.description: Document released and published; visible to readers.

evts.name: newversioncreated
evts.description: A new version of the document has been created.

evts.name: changeproposalscreated
evts.description: Change proposals can be created for a document.

evts.name: validityextensionprocessinitiated
evts.description: Process for extending validity initiated for a document.

evts.name: overrideprocessinitiated
evts.description: AKS Override process initiated for a document.

evts.name: reactivationprocessinitiated
evts.description: Process for reactivation initiated for a document.

evts.name: translationapprovalprocessinitiated
evts.description: Translation approval process initiated for a document.
